rounds.prompt: A polished mirror gives which reflection?
rounds.explain: Smooth surfaces keep rays parallel — regular reflection.

rounds.prompt: Match each surface to its reflection type.
In diffused reflection, the laws of reflection are…
rounds.explain: Each tiny point still obeys i = r; the surface is just uneven.

rounds.prompt: Can reflected light reflect off a second mirror?
rounds.explain: Light can bounce again and again, each time obeying the laws.

rounds.prompt: We can see a wall from any angle because of…
rounds.explain: Scattered light reaches our eyes from all directions.
